The campus is spread over 45 acres of land, economically utilized for the College, Hostels, Staff Quarters, Play Fields and Gardens. PSG College of Technology, under the guidance of illustrious Managing Trustees Sri G R Govindarajulu, Dr G R Damodaran, Sri G Varadaraj, Sri G R Karthikeyan, Sri V. Rajan, Sri G.Rangaswamy and presently under Sri L Gopalakrishnan, all with foresight and far reaching vision, has been in the forefront of innovation in technical education. The founder Principal Dr G R Damodaran was instrumental in the planned growth of the institution from the humble beginnings in 1951 to the present status of a world-renowned technological institution. Dr G R Damodaran was succeeded by Dr R Subbayyan, Dr K Venkataraman, Dr A Shanmugasundaram, Dr S Subramanyan, Dr P Radhakrishnan, Dr S Vijayarangan, Dr R Rudramoorthy and Dr K Prakasan as Principal

Thilagavathi is Principal (FAC). The College today has a student strength of about 8518 with 15 engineering and technology departments besides the computer applications, management sciences, basic sciences and humanities departments. The college offers 21 Undergraduate programmes including BE/BTech/BSc and 24 Postgraduate programmes including ME/MTech/MSc (5 year Integrated)/MSc (2 year)/MBA/MCA. Among the various Undergraduate and Postgraduate programmes offered by the college, as many as 18 programmes were accredited in the year 1997 itself by the National Board of Accreditation of AICTE. The departments are greatly benefited by the expertise of more than 15 visiting faculty from renowned institutions and industries. Each department conducts annually at least one National / International Conference / Seminar / Works

title: About PSG College of Technology
content: aculty from renowned institutions and industries. Each department conducts annually at least one National / International Conference / Seminar / Workshop for effective dissemination of state-of-art technologies and research findings for the benefit of teaching faculty and industries. On an average every year, five short term programmes on current topics of interest are conducted for the teaching faculty from other colleges with funding from AICTE / ISTE and other agencies. More than 505 research scholars are pursuing research programmes leading to Ph D / MS / M Tech degrees and the college is a recognized QIP centre for Postgraduate and Ph D programmes. The college is extremely proud of its alumni, a considerable number of them being entrepreneurs or senior executives in industries both within India and abroad. Some of them are holding prestigious positions like Chief Executive and Managing Director and also as Chairmen of various disciplines in universities abroad. A good number of ou

A good number of our alumni occupied the position of Vice Chancellor in various reputed universities in India . A few educational institutions have also been established by our alumni. Several advanced centres are set up with financial support from the Ministry of Human Resources Development, DST and other agencies. These include: the CAD/CAM/CIM Centre, Virtual Reality Centre, Virtual Instrumentation Centre, Educational Technology Centre, Centre for Non-Formal and Continuing Education, PROJECT IMPACT Centre (a project funded by the World Bank, Swiss Development Corporation and the Government of India), UNDP Jute Project Centre, TIFAC - CORE, Rapid Prototyping and Manufacturing Centre, Festo-PSG Centre for Pneumatic and Control Engineering, Metals Testing and Research Centre, Industry Institute Partnership Cell and CII - TDB TNET Centre. The programmes of the college are recognized all over India and abroad. The college maintains close interaction with several R&D Institutions and institutions of higher learning in India and abroad, through institutional network programmes and collaborative research programmes. It also has close collaborative links with industries in the fields of Automotive, Aerospace, Defence, Textile, Machine Tools, Software Development and Consumer durables. The college has been the recipient of several prestigious projects and International funding support. The college was conferred the AUTONOMOUS STATUS by the University of Madras in the academic year 1978-79, which is continued by the Bharathiar University and subsequently by Anna University. Vision PSG College of Technology aspires to be recognised as one of the leaders in engineering education, research and application of knowledge to benefit society. Mission Our mission as an institution is to: Provide world-class Engineering Education, foster Research and Development, evolve Innovative applications of Technology, encourage Entrepreneurship, ultimately mould young men and women capable of assuming Leadership of the society for the betterment of the country.

title: PSG Tech Overview & Key Institutional Facts
content:
PSG College of Technology (PSG Tech) is a premier government-aided, autonomous, private engineering institution established in 1951 in Peelamedu, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India.
Founded by PSG & Sons' Charities Trust under the visionary leadership of Sri G.R. Govindarajulu and Dr. G.R. Damodaran.
Affiliation: Affiliated to Anna University, Chennai. Approved by AICTE, New Delhi.
Accreditation: Accredited by NAAC with the prestigious 'A++' Grade. All engineering departments are accredited by NBA.
Counselling Code: Anna University TNEA / TANCET Counselling Code is 2006.
Campus Features: 45+ acre sprawling green campus, state-of-the-art laboratory facilities, Central Library, PSG-STEP (Science & Technology Entrepreneurial Park), sports grounds, student hostels, and industry-institute collaborative centers.

title: Admissions & Eligibility Guide (UG, PG, MCA, MBA)
content:
Admission to PSG College of Technology is conducted through merit-based government quotas and management quotas:
1. B.E. / B.Tech Admissions: Through Tamil Nadu Engineering Admissions (TNEA) single-window counseling conducted by the Directorate of Technical Education (DoTE) / Anna University. TNEA Counselling Code: 2006. Minimum eligibility: 10+2 with Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry.
2. Lateral Entry (2nd Year B.E./B.Tech): For Diploma and B.Sc graduates through Centralized Lateral Entry Counselling.
3. M.E. / M.Tech Admissions: Through TANCA counselling based on GATE / CEETA-PG scores.
4. MCA (Master of Computer Applications): 2-year full-time postgraduate degree. Eligibility: Passed BCA / B.Sc (Computer Science / IT) or undergraduate degree with Mathematics at 10+2 or Degree level with at least 50% marks (45% for reserved category). Admission through TANCET conducted by Anna University.
5. MBA Admissions: Through TANCET / MAT / CAT scores via centralized counselling or management

title: Admissions & Eligibility Guide (UG, PG, MCA, MBA)
content:
Admission through TANCET conducted by Anna University.
5. MBA Admissions: Through TANCET / MAT / CAT scores via centralized counselling or management admission.

title: Hostels & Residential Facilities (Boys & Girls)
content:
PSG Tech provides on-campus hostel accommodation for both male and female students:
Boys Hostels: Located adjacent to the academic blocks with multiple blocks (Junior, Senior, PG blocks).
Girls Hostels: Located securely within campus premises with biometric entry and round-the-clock security.
Facilities: 24/7 high-speed Wi-Fi internet, RO purified drinking water, hot water geysers, indoor sports room, gymnasium, reading rooms, TV hall, and laundry services.
Mess: Both vegetarian and non-vegetarian mess facilities offering hygienic South Indian and North Indian food. Monthly mess bill is based on dividing system.
Timings & Curfew: General hostel gates close at 8:30 PM on weekdays. Special late permission can be availed via parent/warden authorization for academic project works or laboratory sessions.

title: Placements & Career Guidance Highlights
content:
PSG Tech boasts a legendary placement record with over 90% placement consistency year-on-year:
Top Recruiters: Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Cisco, Qualcomm, DE Shaw, Texas Instruments, Oracle, SAP, Zoho, TCS, Infosys, Cognizant, Wipro, Caterpillar, L&T, Robert Bosch, Tata Motors, Ashok Leyland, and Goldman Sachs.
Salary Statistics:
- Highest Domestic Package: Up to ₹52 LPA - ₹56 LPA.
- Average Package: ₹11.5 LPA - ₹12.5 LPA across engineering streams.
- Dream & Super Dream offers: Over 300+ students receive packages exceeding ₹15 LPA.
Training & Placement Cell conducts aptitude tests, soft skills bootcamps, technical coding assessments, and mock interviews starting from 3rd year.

title: Academic Regulations & Attendance Policy
content:
Under Autonomous Regulations of PSG College of Technology:
Attendance Policy: Minimum required attendance is 75% in every course to be eligible to appear for the Autonomous End-Semester Examinations (ESE). Students having between 65% and 74% attendance due to documented medical reasons or authorized college representation may apply for condonation. Students below 65% attendance must repeat the course.
Continuous Assessment (CA): Includes tests (CA1, CA2), assignments, tutorials, quizzes, and mini-projects contributing towards internal marks.
Grading System: 10-point scale: O (Outstanding, 10), A+ (Excellent, 9), A (Very Good, 8), B+ (Good, 7), B (Above Average, 6), C (Average, 5), RA (Reappear, 0).

title: Campus Facilities, Central Library & Working Hours
content:
PSG Tech Campus Resources:
Dr. G.R. Damodaran Central Library: Holds over 2,50,000 volumes, 50,000+ e-journals (IEEE, ScienceDirect, Springer, ASME, ASCE), and digital learning facilities. Working hours: 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM on all working days.
Health Center: 24x7 medical assistance with qualified resident medical officers, emergency ambulance service connected to PSG Hospitals, Peelamedu.
Sports & Recreation: 400m athletic track, football ground, cricket nets, basketball courts with floodlights, tennis courts, and modern indoor badminton stadium.
Transport: Extensive fleet of college buses operating across Coimbatore, Tirupur, Pollachi, and Mettupalayam routes.
